metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.replyRate
metrics.label: Reply rate

dimensions.name: googleBusinessProfile.reviewReplyDate

dimensions.name: googleBusinessProfile.reviewUpdateTime

entities.name: performance
entities.label: Performance
entities.description: Daily calls, direction requests, website clicks, bookings and Search and Maps impressions.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.searchImpressions
metrics.label: Search impressions
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Search results. (Desktop + Mobile)

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.searchImpressionsDesktop
metrics.label: Search impressions (desktop)
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Search results on desktop.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.searchImpressionsMobile
metrics.label: Search impressions (mobile)
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Search results on mobile.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.mapsImpressions
metrics.label: Maps impressions
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Maps results. (Desktop + Mobile)

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.mapsImpressionsDesktop
metrics.label: Maps impressions (desktop)
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Maps results on desktop.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.mapsImpressionsMobile
metrics.label: Maps impressions (mobile)
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Maps results on mobile.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.directionRequests
metrics.label: Direction requests
metrics.description: Number of times users requested directions to the business location.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.webClicks
metrics.label: Website clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the website link from the business profile.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.callClicks
metrics.label: Call clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the phone number from the business profile.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.foodOrders
metrics.label: Food orders
metrics.description: Number of food orders placed through the business profile.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.conversations
metrics.label: Messages
metrics.description: Number of messages sent to the business through the profile.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.bookings
metrics.label: Bookings
metrics.description: Number of bookings made through the business profile.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.clicks
metrics.label: Clicks
metrics.description: Number of clicks on the business profile. (Website + Call + Direction Requests)

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.impressions
metrics.label: Impressions
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Search and Maps results. (Desktop + Mobile)

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.desktopImpressions
metrics.label: Impressions (desktop)
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Search and Maps on desktop. Multiple impressions by a unique user within a single day are counted once.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.mobileImpressions
metrics.label: Impressions (mobile)
metrics.description: Number of times the business profile appeared in Google Search and Maps on mobile. Multiple impressions by a unique user within a single day are counted once.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.searchClickThroughRate
metrics.label: Search CTR
metrics.description: Percentage of Search impressions that resulted in a website click: web clicks ÷ search impressions.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.mapsClickThroughRate
metrics.label: Maps CTR
metrics.description: Percentage of Maps impressions that resulted in a website click: web clicks ÷ maps impressions.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.callClickThroughRateSearch
metrics.label: Call CTR (Search)
metrics.description: Percentage of Search impressions that resulted in a call click: call clicks ÷ search impressions.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.callClickThroughRateMaps
metrics.label: Call CTR (Maps)
metrics.description: Percentage of Maps impressions that resulted in a call click: call clicks ÷ maps impressions.

entities.name: keywords
entities.label: Search keywords
entities.description: The search terms people used to find each profile, by month.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.searchVolume
metrics.label: Search Keyword Volume
metrics.description: Number of times users searched with this keyword and saw your business profile. Only keywords with a search volume greater than the threshold are included.

metrics.name: googleBusinessProfile.searchVolumeThreshold
metrics.label: Search Keyword Threshold
metrics.description: Minimum search volume threshold at which keyword impressions are reported by Google.

dimensions.name: googleBusinessProfile.searchKeyword
dimensions.label: Search Keyword
dimensions.description: Search keyword that triggered an impression of your business profile.

dimensions.name: googleBusinessProfile.isBranded
dimensions.label: Branded search
dimensions.description: True when the search keyword contains the location title (case-insensitive). Requires locationName in the same query.
